block.mqtt.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.mqtt.model.title: MQTT
block.mqtt.model.description: Exchange bounded JSON or text messages with an explicitly configured external MQTT broker.
block.mqtt.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.mqtt.help_broker_host: Explicit hostname or IP; empty leaves the block inactive. Never supplied by graph messages.
block.mqtt.help_broker_port: TLS brokers commonly use 8883; set the actual configured port.
block.mqtt.help_tls: Certificate and hostname verification cannot be bypassed. Disable only for anonymous trusted local tests.
block.mqtt.help_secret_ref: Optional secret:// reference to JSON with username and password. Credentials require TLS.
block.mqtt.help_subscriptions: Array of MQTT filters. + matches one level; # must be the final whole level. Maximum 16.
block.mqtt.help_publish_topics: An empty list disables publishing. Incoming requests cannot broaden this allowlist.
block.mqtt.help_payload_format: Strict JSON or UTF-8 text. Binary audio is not transported here.
block.mqtt.help_ca_file: Optional trusted PEM CA file, resolved relative to the application root.
block.mqtt.help_qos: QoS 0 sends without broker acknowledgement; QoS 1 can deliver duplicates. Not exactly-once business processing.
block.mqtt.help_allow_retained: Allow retained reception and explicit retained publishing. Off by default.
block.mqtt.help_clean_session: When disabled, configure a unique stable client ID. Broker retention does not persist this block’s outgoing queue.
block.mqtt.help_client_id: Optional for clean sessions; otherwise required. Never share one between concurrently running nodes.
block.mqtt.help_connect_timeout_sec: Whole connection/subscription deadline, including DNS. Stop terminates the supervised helper.
block.mqtt.help_reconnect_attempts: Additional attempts after a failure. Explicit resume can restart a stopped connection.
block.mqtt.help_reconnect_delay_sec: Wait between bounded attempts. No automatic replay of uncertain outgoing requests.
block.mqtt.help_max_payload_bytes: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per payload. Oversized messages are refused.
block.mqtt.help_max_queue: Bounded outstanding requests. Disconnection reports uncertainty instead of retrying them.
block.mqtt.help_max_messages_per_sec: Disconnect visibly on overload instead of growing an unbounded application queue.
